name: Hoshizaki Hime
source:
Occupation: "Pet" Idol
Activities: Frisbee Club
Likes: Biscuits
Hobbies: Going on walks
Special skills: Making meatballs
Problem areas: Doesn't like spicy things or green onions
The protagonist’s Pomeranian with the ability to become human. Though Hime works hard as an idol, she is still a rather spoiled dog who will beg and cry for treats and attention. 
As the protagonist’s pet, she shares the same surname as him and Amane. 
She also hates doorbells.
Her measurements grow up to 75(A)-60-80
